note: HPR Sim's free body (hpr_sim::FreeBody: the flight's gravity, Coriolis force, air, wind, rigid-body equations and default integrator, under the test's damping or drag) against each code's file over 30 s. A difference is HPR Sim's value less the code's; a largest one is the largest in size over the file's samples, with its sign. A position is compared as the distance between HPR Sim's and the code's, each in Earth-fixed axes, the code's from its latitude, longitude and altitude on WGS 84. spread is the largest difference (or distance) between any two kept codes at a time every one of them has; a code is left out when leaving it cuts the spread of all by more than half. model_difference is the case's named difference between the two models, computed apart from the flight, or 0 where none is named. left_of_the_largest_difference is a code's largest difference less the model difference at the same sample, and a quantity is traced when that is no more than the spread for every kept code. largest_unexplained is the same subtraction's largest at any sample, a stricter figure: against a kept code that itself sets the spread it comes to the spread plus HPR Sim's own distance from the other codes, so its part over the spread is given, with HPR Sim's largest unexplained part from the kept code nearest it, at the default tolerances and at tight ones (tight_tolerance, relative and absolute). Figures keep four significant digits.
reference: NASA/TM-2015-218675, Volumes I and II (Murri, Jackson and Shelton 2015), errata of 2025-09-08, and the codes' time histories published with it
